name: AdaCL.Queue

documentation.description:
-
  @summary
  Queues for Multitasking.

  @description
  An Ada.Containers.Synchronized_Queue_Interfaces-inspired multitasking queue. The queue is strictly bounded and
  pre-allocated. The most important additional feature is the included end-of-data handling. It is possible to
  mark the queue as “finished” (the last data element has been added) and then wait for that last element to
  be processed. On the dequeue side the receiver is also informed that no further elements are available so that
  appropriate actions can be taken (for example closing files).

  There is also a tasked version. This version is abstract and all dequeues happen in a separate thread.

  Finally there is an abort option to terminate the queue when an abnormal condition is encountered. That would
  usually happen on the enqueue side.

  The queue uses smart pointers so that the user does not need to worry about memory handling.

formals.name: Element_Type
formals.description: The type of elements stored in the queue.

formals.name: Null_Element
formals.description:
Null element used as a placeholder when the
:                              queue is empty. A Null_Element may itself be
:                              enqueued and will be processed like any other
:                              element.

formals.description:
Default maximum size of the queue.
